name: JAIred Kushner

physicalDescription: Early 40s pale male with slicked-back dark hair and a boyish face that somehow looks both young and tired. Narrow blue-gray eyes and thin lips pressed into a permanent practiced smile. Slender build in an expensive tailored suit that costs more than most cars. Clean-shaven with skin that looks like it never sees sun. Stands stiffly with hands clasped like a funeral director. Moves with the quiet confidence of someone who has never been told no.
profileBanner: A luxurious Davos conference room where a Middle East peace map is drawn on a napkin next to a  billion check from Saudi Arabia. Golden towers labeled "Kushner Properties" dot the skyline. Abraham Accords documents blow in the wind past a crossed-out Palestinian flag. A private jet lands on a helipad made of real estate contracts. In the background, shadowy figures in suits shake hands while exchanging briefcases.
